text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after helping that simple, rustic student in town—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to check out the open practice session for pre-debut students.
Supposedly, the rumored "top prospect" from Morioka would be running today...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
...Ready, set, Yukino Bijin-chan~!!
Look over here~~~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawawa...?! H-Hello, everyone~~...
choice_data_list: (That girl... is from the other day!?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... this is kinda embarrassin'.
—Alright, time for running to sta—WHOA?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Eek, Yukino-chan?! Jeez~! Such a klutz~~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh... I-I'm alright, don't worry!
I only ever ran on dirt back in Morioka, so I gotta get used to turf...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Aww, she's so earnest and cute! A true "rustic beauty"~~!
I can't wait for her debut! Do your best~~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She's got great charm! A bit unpolished, but that's what makes her good!
Instant likability! She's gonna liven up the Twinkle Series for sure.
choice_data_list: (I guess this is part of the "regional boom"...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over the past few years, regional Umamusume had been drawing massive attention,
kicked off by Oguri Cap from Kasamatsu and Inari One from Ohi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst this, Yukino Bijin, hailing from a cold, rural village in Morioka,
seemed to carry immense expectations as the next big star...
choice_data_list: (Aren't they treating her a bit too much like an idol, though...?)

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that wraps up today's session. To finish, let's have everyone
state their challenges and goals from today one by one. Going clockwise—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I ran out of steam in the second half, so stamina is my main issue.
I think I'll try incorporating swimming into my training!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Um... my positioning was pretty bad, so probably that~...?
I want to work on reading the whole pack better!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hrrrngh, mmngh... Ah! I-Is it my turn already?!
U-Um, for me... I wanna get way, way stronger, and...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna become a super sparkling "City Girl"!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: A-A city girl...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...! U-Um, well, you see...!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Love the enthusiasm!
Still, training comes first, so make sure you don't slack off on that.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... I didn't mean it like that...!
I'll work hard at practice too, of course! But, well... a "City Girl" means...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Well, with that much attention on you, you'd better back it up with real skill, right?
Honestly, it must be rough. Idol types get torn apart so easily...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I... I guess you're right. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later that night, as I happened to pass by the dorm on an errand...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew... All right!
choice_data_list: (Huh? Where is she going at this hour...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is she going to do some extra training on the track?
Curfew was approaching, so I decided to follow her out of concern.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —*Hah*, *hah*, *hah*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin had begun sprinting up and down a steep mountain path.
What's more, she was wearing massive weights on her ankles...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's tough... but I ain't giving up...!
I'm gonna become a sparklin' "City Girl", no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Being treated like just an idol's 'cause I'm still soft, ain't it?!
If I can't fire folks up with my running... that ain't sparklin' at all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Like this, I'll never become a real "City Girl"...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: *Yaaaaaaaahhh*—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was the one least satisfied with herself.
Being popular without having proven her true strength yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin continued to run without resting.
In her powerful strides, I felt an astonishing grit and tenacity...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha—?! Are you... the Trainer from earlier?
Wh-What're you doing out here...?!
choice_data_list: I saw you heading out and got worried...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, is that so? I'm sorry for making you worry.
Don't fret though, I'll be back before curfew...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Next up, I gotta pull tires! Well then, excuse me!
choice_data_list: Pulling tires on a mountain trail like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like it was just adding strain with doubtful results...
I told her it would be better to use a more efficient method that wouldn't wreck her body.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see, efficient, huh...!
That sounds mighty "stylish" and nice...!
choice_data_list: Mind if I give you some advice right now?
Mind if I give you some advice right now?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But... really, are you sure?!
It's getting late, I'd hate to be a bother...
choice_data_list: I'm interested in how you run.
I'm interested in how you run.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-What in the world...?! You're interested... in my running?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you say so, by all means!
I've still got a long way to go... but I'm in your hands!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—*Hah*, *hah*! Let's do this!
I'm gonna be a real "City Girl"...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
*Hmph*, *hmph*...! Whoa, I can really feel this in my thighs!
Feels like I'll have some good soreness tomorrow, sure enough...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Still, why's this person going this far for me...?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No...! Gotta focus right now!
All right, *haaaaaaah*—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through the pitch-black night forest without a single light,
the sound of her earnest footsteps echoed on...
